precheck.description: Schema "_prisma" must hold no tables or other relations while schema "prisma_contract" exists. This release keeps Prisma's own tables in "_prisma", and "prisma_contract" holds the tables a release candidate of Prisma 8 created, so Prisma does not choose between them. Follow the upgrade instructions before dropping either schema.
precheck.sql:
SELECT to_regnamespace($1) IS NULL
  OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_class WHERE relnamespace = to_regnamespace($1)) AS "result"

precheck.description: The role that runs this command must have the privileges of the role that owns schema "prisma_contract", because renaming a schema needs them. Find the owner with SELECT nspowner::regrole FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = 'prisma_contract'. Then run the command once as that role, or give the schema to the migrating role with ALTER SCHEMA "prisma_contract" OWNER TO <migrating role>.
precheck.sql:
SELECT (SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user)
  OR pg_has_role(current_user, nspowner, 'USAGE') AS "result"
FROM pg_namespace WHERE nspname = $1

precheck.description: The role that runs this command must have the CREATE privilege on the database, because renaming schema "prisma_contract" needs it. Grant it with GRANT CREATE ON DATABASE <database> TO <migrating role>, or run the command once as a role that has it.
precheck.sql:
SELECT (SELECT rolsuper FROM pg_roles WHERE rolname = current_user)
  OR has_database_privilege(current_database(), 'CREATE') AS "result"

execute.description: drop schema "_prisma" if it exists, which the database refuses when anything is in it

postcheck.description: Schema "prisma_contract" must no longer exist once it is renamed to "_prisma".

postcheck.sql: SELECT to_regnamespace($1) IS NOT NULL AS "result"

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "_prisma"."marker" (
  "space" text DEFAULT 'app' NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
  "core_hash" text NOT NULL,

  "contract_json" jsonb,
  "canonical_version" int,
  "updated_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "app_tag" text,
  "meta" jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb NOT NULL,
  "invariants" text[] DEFAULT '{}'::text[] NOT NULL
)

WITH "table" AS (
  SELECT c.oid FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace
  WHERE n.nspname = $1 AND c.relname = $2
)
SELECT NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "table") OR EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM pg_attribute a JOIN "table" t ON a.attrelid = t.oid
  WHERE a.attname = $3 AND NOT a.attisdropped
    AND format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) = $4 AND a.attnotnull = $5
) AS "result"
